authoritative: version-1 events in the append-only SQLite ledger

promotion_rule: All executable milestone-1 criteria pass; any worst-region failure rejects the candidate even when pooled metrics pass.
rollback_rule: Append a disabling control event immediately, stop reads of invalid artifacts, and rebuild from the surviving ledger image.

mechanisms.name: append-only authoritative ledger
mechanisms.scope: one SQLite database; no distributed consensus
mechanisms.cost: O(batch size) writes and O(event count) integrity replay
mechanisms.tradeoff: full event retention uses more storage than in-place mutation
mechanisms.failure_response: reject the batch, preserve the prior frontier, and stop derived compilation if integrity verification fails
kill_criteria: K1: repeated replay produces more than one resolved snapshot hash
K2: interruption at any insert boundary exposes a partial batch
K3: an update or delete against an event row succeeds

mechanisms.name: artifact stamp and support manifest
authoritative_inputs: recorded candidate and evidence event IDs
mechanisms.scope: all derived artifacts, including indexes and future model adapters
mechanisms.cost: O(candidate lineage size) frontier and support validation
mechanisms.tradeoff: conservative support invalidation may temporarily disable useful derived state
mechanisms.failure_response: make the artifact unusable; do not downgrade missing lineage to a warning
permitted_mutations: create a new immutable artifact version
kill_criteria: K4: an artifact with incomplete required stamp fields is readable
K5: an artifact cites evidence absent from its recorded frontier
K6: an all-support artifact remains usable after one support event is invalidated

mechanisms.name: regional compile adequacy and two-sided deletion
assumptions: synthetic probes have known evidence IDs
region membership is versioned by ontology
mechanisms.cost: O(events plus protected probes) per compiler candidate
mechanisms.tradeoff: tail coverage may increase artifact size and retrieval cost
mechanisms.failure_response: reject the compiler candidate and retain the full ledger representation
kill_criteria: K7: any protected region falls below the coverage floor even if pooled coverage passes
K8: any fully invalidated evidence remains retrievable after single or batched deletion
K9: any surviving evidence becomes unavailable after repair
K10: repaired and clean-from-scratch indexes have different content hashes

mechanisms.name: hybrid retrieval with selection journal
assumptions: hashed character features are a small non-neural semantic baseline
mechanisms.scope: document and episode text fields in Event v1 payloads
mechanisms.cost: O(indexed documents) per query in the milestone prototype
mechanisms.tradeoff: complete candidate logging consumes audit storage
mechanisms.failure_response: block durable outputs when a journal cannot be appended or selected support is invalid
permitted_mutations: append one immutable retrieval journal record per query
kill_criteria: K11: a retrieval omits an indexed rival from its candidate journal
K12: a journal omits scores, filters, versions, selections, or the top-k margin
K13: a previously selected tombstoned item remains selectable before rebuild
